blocks.text: Antibody Y shakal ka protein hai. Yeh chaar polypeptide chains se bani hai: do aik jaisi lambi (heavy) chains aur do chhoti (light) chains. Chaaron chains disulfide bridges (pulon) se aapas mein jori hoti hain. Har chain ka aik constant region hota hai (aik hi class ki tamam antibodies mein milta julta) aur aik variable region (jo har antibody mein mukhtalif hota hai). Y ke har baazu mein aik heavy aur aik light chain ke variable regions mil kar aik khaas binding site (jurne ki jagah) banate hain. Mukhtalif antibodies ke variable regions mukhtalif hote hain. Isi liye antibodies specific hoti hain, yaani sirf usi khaas antigen ki tabahi ka sabab banti hain jis ne unhein banwaya tha.

blocks.alt: Y shakal ki antibody. Do heavy chains tana aur har baazu ka andaruni hissa banati hain; har baazu ke bairooni taraf aik light chain. Har chain ka sira variable region (sabz) hai, baqi constant region (narangi). Disulfide pul dono heavy chains ko aur har light chain ko us ki heavy chain se jorte hain. Bracket dono baazuon ke siron par binding sites dikhata hai.
